_note: Hover help for File Manager's buttons, check boxes and tabs (project-owned). Key = the control's text, optionally preceded by where it is (tab / sub-tab / group box titles, or a dialog's title), joined with ' > '. The most specific match wins; '&', a trailing '...' and case are ignored.

ToolTips.Drives: Every drive in the catalog: its priority for keeping copies, register, health check, open, forget.
ToolTips.Scan: Quick scan a drive (names and sizes) and run the content check (reads the files that might be duplicates).
ToolTips.Duplicates: Folders that are copies of each other, biggest saving first. Pick the keeper, find contained folders, open Actions.
ToolTips.Reports: Every batch of moves (continue, undo, delete its duplicates after a re-check), the scan history and the exports.
ToolTips.Consolidate: Later, when there is room: copy a drive's _Clean to one NTFS drive with Robocopy, verify every file, remove the verified source files.
ToolTips.Drives > Register drive: Add the connected drive picked on the left to the catalog (scanning a drive also registers it).
ToolTips.Drives > Refresh: Read the drive list again (plug drives in and out as you like).
ToolTips.Drives > Set priority: Give the selected drive this priority. When two copies are otherwise equal, the copy on the drive with the lower number is kept.
ToolTips.Drives > Health check: Show what Windows knows about the health of each disk (Get-PhysicalDisk). Many USB enclosures hide the drive's own health data.
ToolTips.Drives > Open drive: Open the selected drive in Explorer.
ToolTips.Drives > Forget drive: Remove the selected drive and its files from the catalog. Nothing on the drive changes; scan it again to bring it back.
ToolTips.Scan > Refresh drives: Read the list of connected drives again.
ToolTips.Scan > Full content check after the quic: After the quick scan, read every file in folders that might be duplicates and hash it, so matches are confirmed by content. Takes hours for terabytes.
ToolTips.Scan > Also hash every file whose size m: Hash more files: every file that has the same size as another file anywhere. Needed for Find contained folders and the file phase. Slower.
ToolTips.Scan > Show actions when done: Open the Actions window when a scan finishes.
ToolTips.Scan > Content check only: Read and hash the files that might be duplicates on every connected drive. Files already hashed are skipped, so this also carries on after Stop.
ToolTips.Scan > Stop: Stop after the current file. Work done so far is kept.
ToolTips.Scan > Settings > Save settings: Save the ignore lists and the smallest folder size. They apply to the next scan and the next Find duplicates.
ToolTips.Duplicates > Find duplicates: Group the scanned folders by content again (after a scan, a new keeper pick or a priority change).
ToolTips.Duplicates > Include quick matches: Also group folders that only match by file sizes (not content-checked yet). They show in orange.
ToolTips.Duplicates > Actions: Open the Actions window: move duplicates to _Duplicates, move everything else to _Clean, export reports.
ToolTips.Duplicates > Find contained folders: Find folders whose files are all inside another, bigger folder. Works best after a content check with 'Also hash every file whose size matches another file'.
ToolTips.Duplicates > Duplicate groups: Groups of folders with the same content and the copies of the selected group.
ToolTips.Duplicates > Contained folders: Folders whose files are all inside another, bigger folder (report only).
ToolTips.Duplicates > Duplicate groups > Make kee: Keep the copy selected in the lower list instead (then the groups are worked out again).
ToolTips.Duplicates > Duplicate groups > Open fol: Open the copy selected in the lower list in Explorer.
ToolTips.Duplicates > Duplicate groups > Clear my: Forget every keeper you picked by hand and use the automatic choice again.
ToolTips.Duplicates > Contained folders > Open co: Open the selected contained folder in Explorer.
ToolTips.Actions > Move duplicate folders to _Dup: Move each duplicate to X:\_Duplicates\<kept folder path>\<name>\<name> (n) on its own drive, with an _origin.txt inside.
ToolTips.Actions > Move keepers and unique folder: Move everything else at the top of each ticked drive into X:\_Clean, keeping the folder paths.
ToolTips.Actions > Include quick matches (not con: Also move duplicates that only match by file sizes. Not recommended: run the content check instead.
ToolTips.Actions > Export duplicates report (CSV): Save every duplicate group and copy to a CSV file (opens in Excel).
ToolTips.Actions > Export HTML report: Save a report of drives, duplicate groups and batches as a web page.
ToolTips.Reports > Batches: Every batch of moves and its steps.
ToolTips.Reports > Batches > Show commands: Show the PowerShell that was shown before the selected batch ran.
ToolTips.Reports > Batches > Export batch CSV: Save every step of the selected batch to a CSV file.
ToolTips.Reports > Batches > Export duplicates CS: Save every duplicate group and copy to a CSV file.
ToolTips.Reports > Batches > Export HTML report: Save a report of drives, duplicate groups and batches as a web page.
ToolTips.Consolidate > Refresh drives: Read the list of connected drives again.
ToolTips.Consolidate > Browse: Pick the target folder (for example T:\_Clean on an NTFS drive).
ToolTips.Consolidate > Copy with Robocopy: Copy the source drive's _Clean into the target in a Robocopy window. Files already in the target are never overwritten.
ToolTips.Consolidate > Verify copy: Read every file on both sides and compare them. The result is listed below; problems in the lower list.
ToolTips.Consolidate > Remove verified source fil: Permanently delete only the source files the selected verify run found identical in the target.
ToolTips.Consolidate > Stop: Stop the running verify or remove after the current file.
ToolTips.Actions > Build plan: Work out every move and open them in a list with tick boxes. Nothing moves until you tick steps and click Move selected.
ToolTips.Reports > Batches > Open batch: Open the selected batch: tick steps to move, undo, or delete (duplicates). Double-clicking a batch does the same.
ToolTips.Drives > Start fresh: Empty the catalog (drives, scans, hashes, duplicate groups) to begin again. Nothing on any drive changes. You choose whether to keep the batch history.
ToolTips.Select all: Tick every step shown (the filter decides what is shown).
ToolTips.Not done yet: Tick only the steps shown that have not run yet (planned or failed).
ToolTips.Duplicates only: Tick only the duplicate folders shown (moves to _Duplicates).
ToolTips._Clean only: Tick only the folders and files shown that go to _Clean.
ToolTips.Tick highlighted: Tick the rows you highlighted (click, Shift+click, Ctrl+click).
ToolTips.Move selected: Move the ticked steps that have not run yet. You see the exact commands first (Move / Cancel). Duplicates inside a ticked _Clean folder move first.
ToolTips.Undo selected: Move the ticked steps that are done back to where they were.
ToolTips.Delete selected duplicates: Permanently delete the ticked duplicates from _Duplicates, after reading each one again and comparing it with its kept copy. Anything not identical is kept.
ToolTips.Workflow: The recommended steps as a checklist: where you are, what to do next, and a button to each step.
ToolTips.Scan > Whole drive: Scan the whole drive picked below.
ToolTips.Scan > One folder: Scan only the folder picked below. The rest of that drive in the catalog stays as it is.
ToolTips.Scan > Check only (compare, add nothing): Read every file in the folder picked below and compare it with the catalog: what is already there, and what is new. Nothing is added or moved.
ToolTips.Scan > Browse: Pick the folder to scan or check.
ToolTips.Scan > Start: Start: scan the drive or folder, or check the folder, depending on the choice above (read only).
ToolTips.Actions > Whole drives (ticked below): Plan for the whole drives ticked in the list.
ToolTips.Actions > Only this folder:: Plan for one folder only: its duplicates, and the folder itself to _Clean (keeping its path). Scan it first.
ToolTips.Actions > Browse: Pick the folder to plan for.
ToolTips.Workflow > Refresh: Work out where you are again.
ToolTips.Content check: Open the Scan tab to run Content check only with the drives plugged in.
ToolTips.Open Actions: Open the Actions window to build a plan (nothing moves until you tick steps).
ToolTips.Go to Reports: Open the Reports tab (batches: move, undo or delete the steps you tick).
ToolTips.Check a folder: Open the Scan tab in Check only mode.
ToolTips.Check results > Folders: Each folder: already in the catalog, partly, or new - and where it already is.
ToolTips.Check results > Files not found: The files that are not in the catalog yet (or only matched by size).
ToolTips.Check results > Export CSV: Save the folders and the files not found to a CSV file.
